title: Goal time-to-reach estimate
description: Estimate of how long a user will take to reach a savings goal, based on their recent spending and income.

reachable.description: Whether the goal is reachable at the user's current net-savings pace.

estimatedMonths.description: Whole months to reach the goal from now. Null when the goal is not reachable at the current pace.

monthlyNetSavings.description: The average monthly net savings used for the estimate (echo the input figure).

confidence.description: Reliability of the estimate, derived from the months of history available and how stable income/expenses are.

summary.description: One or two plain-language sentences explaining the estimate.

tips.description: Up to three concrete, specific suggestions to reach the goal faster, ideally referencing the top spending categories. Empty array if none are useful.
